name: fig-08
title: fig-08: Self-organized processes
question: Is the paper's Fig. self_organized_process (§Composition of the cellular interface) executable rather than merely drawn -- does the `fig08-runnable` composite actually demonstrate that a cellular interface EMERGES when molecular processes are compositionally coupled so they maintain one another (metabolism synthesizes the components the membrane and replication need, containment/expression maintain the pools metabolism needs), so that the coupled system holds a sustained, far-from-equilibrium balance rather than each process running down independently?
biological_summary:
This study makes Fig. self_organized_process runnable. The paper's §Composition of the cellular interface asks how molecular processes give rise to a cellular interface: at the molecular level, reactions, transport, and template-directed synthesis act on shared variables, and "a cellular interface emerges when these processes are compositionally coupled so that they maintain one another" -- membrane structure depends on metabolism that synthesizes lipids, metabolism depends on containment to maintain concentrations, and template-directed synthesis maintains the molecular components that realize these processes over time (caption a: self-organized processes -- autocatalysis, membrane formation, template replication -- combine into a self-maintaining organization; caption b: a minimal cell composition diagram -- metabolism, containment, replication supporting each other through shared components).

The `fig08-runnable` composite is the executable form of caption b. It wires the six minimal-cell processes -- containment (assembles membrane from lipids), metabolism (turns enzymes + nutrients into metabolites + energy), gene expression (translates genes + amino_acids into proteins + enzymes), replication (copies genes by spending energy, returns nucleic_acids), diffusion (metabolite turnover), and mass-action reactions (interconvert building blocks) -- over ten FLAT scalar building-block pools they all share (membrane, lipids, metabolites, nutrients, amino_acids, nucleic_acids, enzymes, proteins, genes, energy). Because the processes share those pools, none stands alone: gene expression makes the enzymes metabolism needs, metabolism makes the energy replication spends, replication grows the gene template expression reads. This is the paper's closure condition made concrete -- each process's outputs sustain the inputs the others depend on.

Run 40 ticks through the process-bigraph engine (deterministic ODE handlers, no RNG), the coupling holds: every one of the observed pools stays strictly positive and bounded (nothing collapses to zero, nothing explodes -- the largest pool, membrane, reaches only 2.2). The catalytic/template pools hold a sustained steady balance (genes 1.00 -> 1.07, energy 0.50 -> 0.58, metabolites 0.30 -> 0.33, nucleic_acids 0.30 -> 0.29; each drifts < 25% over the second half of the run) while the cell's structural material is net-produced (membrane 0.2 -> 2.2, proteins 0.30 -> 0.88, enzymes 0.30 -> 0.50). That the balance is MAINTAINED by the coupling, not intrinsic to any one pool, is shown by opening the loop: knock metabolism out and its downstream metabolite pool collapses toward zero (0.33 -> 0.011) while energy, whose only source is metabolism, freezes exactly at its 0.5 seed; knock gene expression out and the enzyme pool metabolism depends on freezes exactly at its 0.3 seed, dragging metabolism's own metabolite output down (0.33 -> 0.23). The sustained balance is the composite maintaining one another's inputs, not each process coasting on its own reserves.

This is a didactic, toy-real realization: the pools, rate constants, and yields are hand-chosen so the coupled balance is legible over a 40-tick run, NOT calibrated to a named organism, metabolite, or literature flux. Its rigorous cousin is the `autopoiesis` study in the `draft-to-living-cell` investigation, which realizes the same self-maintenance claim at higher fidelity; this study's job is only to show that the figure's specific caption -- coupled processes maintaining one another into a self-sustaining whole -- runs and holds under test.
claim: Fig. self_organized_process is executable: the `fig08-runnable` composite couples containment, metabolism, gene expression, replication, diffusion, and mass-action reactions over ten shared flat building-block pools, and over a deterministic 40-tick run it demonstrates the caption's exact principle -- the coupled processes maintain one another into a sustained, far-from-equilibrium balance (every pool strictly positive and bounded; template/catalytic pools genes, energy, metabolites, nucleic_acids hold steady within 25% while structural material membrane, proteins, enzymes is net-produced), and that balance is a property of the COUPLING, not of any pool in isolation: removing metabolism starves its downstream metabolite pool toward zero and freezes energy at its seed, and removing gene expression freezes the enzyme pool metabolism depends on and drops metabolism's metabolite output. This is a toy-real didactic demonstration, not a calibrated model; its rigorous cousin is the `autopoiesis` study in `draft-to-living-cell`.
key_assumptions: The `fig08-runnable` composite is a **didactic, toy-real** realization of the figure -- small, illustrative, built to look like Fig. self_organized_process b and play forward. The ten building-block pools, the six processes' rate constants (assembly_rate 0.05, k_cat 0.1, k_expr 0.08, k_rep 0.015, turnover_rate 0.08, k_react 0.06), and the yields are hand-chosen so the coupled balance is legible over 40 ticks. They are NOT calibrated to a named organism, metabolite, enzyme, or literature flux.

The composite integrates over FLAT scalar pools (membrane, lipids, metabolites, ...), not spatially resolved fields or a real membrane geometry. "Containment" here is a scalar membrane-assembly ODE, not a diffusion barrier maintaining a concentration gradient in space. The self-maintenance shown is compositional (shared-pool coupling), not spatial.
The handlers are deterministic ODEs with no random seed, so every number below is exactly reproducible run to run; there is no stochasticity to average over.

The mutual-maintenance loop is demonstrated by process knockout (deleting a process from the state), which drives that process's contribution to its shared pools to zero. This isolates each coupling edge but is a structural intervention on the composite, not a perturbation of a physical rate.
The rigorous cousin is the `autopoiesis` study in the `draft-to-living-cell` investigation; this study does not restate that study's numbers or fidelity as its own.
acceptance_criteria: The coupled composite sustains itself over the full run -- every observed shared pool stays strictly positive (nothing collapses to zero) and bounded (nothing explodes).

The catalytic/template pools (genes, energy, metabolites, nucleic_acids) hold a sustained steady balance across the second half of the run, while the cell's structural material (membrane, proteins, enzymes) is net-produced -- a far-from-equilibrium organization maintaining structure over time, not an equilibrium flatline.

The sustained balance is a property of the coupling, not of any pool in isolation: removing metabolism starves its downstream metabolite pool (toward zero) and freezes the energy pool it is the sole source of.

The maintenance loop closes both ways: removing gene expression, the sole source of the enzyme pool metabolism depends on, freezes that enzyme pool at its seed and lowers metabolism's own metabolite output -- each process's outputs sustain the inputs the others depend on.

conclusion:
## Claims
- Fig. self_organized_process is executable. The `fig08-runnable` composite couples containment, metabolism, gene expression, replication, diffusion, and mass-action reactions over ten shared flat building-block pools, and over a deterministic 40-tick run it demonstrates the caption's exact principle -- the coupled processes maintain one another into a sustained, far-from-equilibrium balance rather than each running down independently.
- The maintained balance holds: every observed pool stays strictly positive and bounded (smallest minimum metabolites 0.267, largest value membrane 2.2), the catalytic/template pools genes, energy, metabolites, nucleic_acids drift < 25% over the second half of the run, and the structural material membrane, proteins, enzymes is net-produced (membrane 0.2 -> 2.2, proteins 0.30 -> 0.88, enzymes 0.30 -> 0.50).
- That balance is a property of the coupling, not of any pool in isolation. Removing metabolism starves its downstream metabolite pool (0.33 -> 0.011) and freezes energy at its 0.5 seed; removing gene expression freezes the enzyme pool metabolism depends on at its 0.3 seed and drops metabolism's metabolite output (0.33 -> 0.23). The loop closes both ways.

## Evidence
- **CLOSURE-SUSTAINS-ITSELF-EVERY-POOL-POSITIVE** -- all seven pool minima > 0 (smallest metabolites 0.267)
- **CLOSURE-IS-BOUNDED-NOTHING-EXPLODES** -- largest value over the run is membrane 2.2
- **TEMPLATE-POOLS-HOLD-A-STEADY-BALANCE** -- second-half drift genes 0.034, energy 0.083, metabolites 0.203, nucleic_acids 0.000 (all < 0.25)
- **STRUCTURAL-MATERIAL-IS-NET-PRODUCED** -- membrane 0.20 -> 2.20, proteins 0.30 -> 0.88, enzymes 0.30 -> 0.50
- **METABOLISM-KNOCKOUT-STARVES-DOWNSTREAM-POOLS** -- metabolites 0.33 -> 0.011, energy frozen at 0.5
- **GENE-EXPRESSION-SUSTAINS-THE-ENZYMES-METABOLISM-DEPENDS-ON** -- enzymes frozen at 0.30, metabolites 0.33 -> 0.23
- **RUNS-DEFAULT-N-STEPS** -- 41 emitted rows == 40 + 1

## Limitations
- `fig08-runnable` is a didactic, toy-real composite: the ten pools, the six processes' rate constants and yields are hand-chosen to make the coupled balance legible over 40 ticks, not calibrated to a named organism, metabolite, enzyme, or literature flux.
- The composite integrates over flat scalar pools, not spatial fields or a real membrane geometry; "containment" is a scalar membrane-assembly ODE, so the self-maintenance shown is compositional (shared-pool coupling), not spatial.
- The rigorous cousin is the `autopoiesis` study in the `draft-to-living-cell` investigation; this study does not restate that study's numbers as its own.

## Next steps
- Compare against the `autopoiesis` cousin to see the same self-maintenance claim at higher fidelity.
- Optionally push a knockout toward full viability collapse to connect this figure's closure to the §Disintegration level-shift studied elsewhere in the paper.

falsifiability: Overturned if any observed pool collapses to zero or blows up over the run, if the template/catalytic pools fail to hold a steady balance (second-half drift >= 25%), if the structural pools are not net-produced, or if either process knockout fails to move its downstream shared pool (metabolism KO not starving metabolites / not freezing energy, or gene-expression KO not freezing enzymes / not lowering metabolites) -- any of which would mean the processes are not actually coupled into a mutually maintaining whole.
